objective: Qualify finite-frequency wave amplification near fold and cusp caustics, then connect uniform wave-optics approximations to Kerr ray-derived arrival-time surfaces and independent strong-field wave-scattering references.
claim_ceiling: This is a benchmark specification only. No Airy/Pearcey kernel, Kerr diffraction amplitude, scattering factor or astrophysical lensing result is implemented or validated by this manifest.

references.title: Strong-field gravitational-wave lensing in the Kerr background
references.role: Independent full-wave Kerr scattering-factor / MST reference
references.required_reproduction: Pin source/lens/observer geometry, spin, incidence, polarization, frequency, normalization and the reported on-axis test.

references.title: Diffraction around caustics in gravitational wave lensing
references.role: Canonical point, fold and cusp diffraction amplitude/phase comparisons

references.title: Strong-Field Gravitational-Wave Lensing from Ray-Traced Arrival-Time Surfaces
references.role: Strong-field ray-derived time-delay surface and diffraction-integral benchmark
references.reported_fixture: Stationary source at 10M; compare stated peak-amplification and first-fringe discrepancy against the paper's relativistic wave-scattering reference.
references.note: The reported 6.5% and 0.3% values are reproduction targets for that exact source/lens configuration, not universal performance targets.

references.title: Strong Field Gravitational Lensing in Full Wave Optics
references.role: Face-on/edge-on binary angular emission structure, spinning lenses, full wave-optics amplification and comparison to ray tracing
references.note: Use the paper's exact source angular radiation pattern, geometry and polarization; do not replace it with an isotropic point source.

references.title: Light propagation prescriptions for black hole movies
references.role: Image-order delay maps and fast/slow/brisk-light validity

references.title: Adaptive Analytical Ray Tracing of Black Hole Photon Rings

scope_separation.canonical_caustic_math: Universal local fold/cusp normal forms; independent of any Kerr solver.
scope_separation.ray_derived_wave_optics: Finite-frequency propagation from a declared arrival-time surface derived from Kerr null rays; not a thin-lens approximation unless explicitly specified.
scope_separation.full_wave_scattering: Independent Kerr perturbation / MST scattering calculation with its own normalization and boundary conditions.
scope_separation.non_claim: Agreement between these different routes is tested only on matched geometries and observables; one route is not silently used as the other's oracle.

conventions.units: geometrized G=c=1 for lens geometry; source/detector frequency conversion is explicit
conventions.phase: exp(+i omega T) in the canonical oscillatory integral; any external reference using another Fourier convention must be transformed explicitly
conventions.angular_frequency: omega = 2*pi*f in physical units, and dimensionless M*omega in geometrized units
conventions.source_model: must declare point, finite/coherent, partially coherent, or extended anisotropic binary source
conventions.polarization: scalar control first; plus/cross or spin-weighted response only under a pinned basis and transport convention
conventions.normalization: all amplification factors carry a named incident-wave normalization and observer flux/strain convention
conventions.arrival_time: reference event and additive time origin are fixed per fixture

fold.oscillatory_integral: Ai(u) = (1/(2*pi)) * integral_R exp(i*(t^3/3 + u*t)) dt, interpreted as an oscillatory integral with a declared regulator/contour prescription

cusp.oscillatory_integral: Pearcey(X,Y) = integral_R exp(i*phi(t;X,Y)) dt, interpreted as an oscillatory integral with a declared regulator/contour prescription

ray_arrival_surface_bridge.mathematical_object: For each declared source/observer branch family, construct the arrival-time phase map from exact Kerr null geodesics and the selected source/observer screen measure. The domain, measure, amplitude factor and normalization are part of the fixture.
ray_arrival_surface_bridge.generic_integral_form: F(omega) = N(omega) * integral_D A(q) * exp(i*omega*T(q)) dmu(q)
constraints: D, dmu, A(q), T(q), boundary terms and N(omega) must be derived for the selected physical setup; the generic formula is not a license to assume a thin lens plane.
Stationary points must correspond to the image branches from #4519 with matched source/observer events.
The Hessian / higher phase derivatives used for fold/cusp normal forms must be independently checked against finite differences or variational derivatives.
Caustic classification and local uniform approximation validity must be explicit; unresolved degeneracy returns Unresolved.
ray_arrival_surface_bridge.geometric_optics_limit: Away from caustics and at high frequency, compare against the stationary-phase sum over image branches with declared Maslov/Morse-phase convention, signed parity and magnification.
ray_arrival_surface_bridge.transition: Near a caustic, replace divergent isolated-image stationary phase with the appropriate uniform canonical approximation; do not clamp divergent magnification.

benchmark_sweeps.dimensionless_frequency: M*omega; logarithmic sweep selected from exact reference paper domain

prospective_acceptance.canonical_fold: Complex amplitude and phase agree with independent high-precision Airy evaluation, with quadrature error decreasing under independent refinement.
prospective_acceptance.canonical_cusp: Complex amplitude and phase agree with independent high-precision Pearcey evaluation, with contour/regulator independence over declared domains.
prospective_acceptance.geometric_optics_limit: Away from caustics, high-frequency uniform result converges to the matched stationary-phase image sum.
prospective_acceptance.caustic_regularity: Finite continuous wave response through fold/cusp transitions; no false finite geometric magnification.
prospective_acceptance.ray_surface_consistency: Stationary points and arrival times agree with #4519 separated-geodesic and independent Hamiltonian outputs.
prospective_acceptance.strong_field_reproduction: Reproduce #2610.18984 and #2511.23110 selected configurations within stated reference discrepancy and independently estimated uncertainty.
prospective_acceptance.polarimetric_reproduction: Plus/cross or spin-weighted output only when incident source pattern and reference polarization basis are pinned.
prospective_acceptance.time_domain: Inverse transform reproduces source/observer time-domain wave packet within truncation, bandwidth and integration error.
prospective_acceptance.efficiency: Runtime/memory compared only at matched complex amplitude/phase error and same source/geometry/frequency coverage.
prospective_acceptance.abstention: Unknown caustic type, unmatched source model, nonconverged oscillatory integral or missing phase derivatives returns a typed unresolved state.
